pushback_verification: Verified: the gateway requirement read 'among entries that are directories', task 1.1 'only DIRECTORIES match', and design D1 'matches DIRECTORIES only' — none said whether a symlink to a directory matches, while task 3.1 tested a symlinked entry's refusal.

resolutions.title: The directory-only rule leaves a symlinked archive entry undefined, so the containment refusal may be unreachable
resolutions.action: an entry matches when it RESOLVES to a directory, symbolic links followed (fs.statSync), so a symlinked entry is admitted and then refused by the containment check, never skipped as a miss — stated in the gateway requirement (with a new scenario for the outside-pointing symlink), design D1 (with why following links keeps the refusal reachable on both surfaces) and task 1.1; task 1.2 gains the symlink case, task 3.1 names the containment error, and both skip symlink cases where the platform cannot create one

introduced.text: among entries that RESOLVE to a directory, symbolic links followed
A symlinked archive entry pointing outside the archive is refused
Following links is what keeps that refusal reachable
a symlink to a directory is returned

final_assessment: One finding resolved as a repair: the resolver's directory rule now follows symbolic links, so the containment refusal is reachable on both surfaces.
